title: Your organization
description: Find the organization you will be representing.

search.label: Organization name or acronym
search.placeholder: Institut de la Francophonie, IFDD, ministry…
search.hint: Two letters are enough to start.

results.count: No organization found | One organization found | {count} organizations found
results.members: No registered member | 1 registered member | {count} registered members
results.sharedDomain: This organization uses the domain of your email address.
results.noneMine: None of these is your organization?

empty.title: No organization matches “{query}”
empty.description: Try the full name or the acronym. If it does not exist yet, create its record.

domain.title: Your address points to an organization
domain.immediate: You will be attached immediately: this domain has been verified by the organization.
domain.approval: A contact person at the organization will need to approve your request.

current.title: Your affiliations
current.pendingHint: A contact person must approve your request. There is no need to send it again.

confirm.title: Join {organization}
confirm.immediate: Your email domain belongs to this organization: you will be attached immediately.
confirm.approval: Your request will be sent to a contact person at the organization, who will approve or decline it.
confirm.jobTitleHint: Optional, but this is what the person handling your request will read.

duplicate.title: This organization may already exist
duplicate.description: Compare both records before continuing. An organization registered twice cannot be merged again without IFDD's help, and its activities end up split between two records.
duplicate.tableCaption: Comparison between the organization you are creating and the one that already exists

joined.title: You are now attached to {organization}
joined.description: You can now submit an activity proposal on behalf of this organization.

pending.title: Request sent to {organization}
pending.description: A contact person at the organization must approve it. You will receive an email as soon as they do.

created.title: {organization} has been created
created.description: You are its contact person. IFDD will review the record; you can start working without waiting for that review.

notices.alreadyMember: You are already a member of {organization}.
notices.alreadyRequested: Your request to {organization} is already pending.
notices.nameTaken: An organization already bears this name in this country. Here it is.

states.contextError: Organizations and countries could not be loaded.
states.signedOut: Your session has expired. Sign in again to attach your account to an organization.

required.generic: This action is carried out on behalf of an organization. Find yours, then pick up where you left off.

reasons.proposal: A proposal is submitted on behalf of an organization. Find yours, then resume your submission.
reasons.organization-space: The organization workspace gathers your body's proposals. Find it to get access.

skip.description: No organization? It is not required: your account is enough to follow the programme and register for sessions.
skip.action: I do not have an organization for now
skip.required: No organization for now? Your account still works to follow the programme.
